_doc: Afrikaans pre-printed statement delivered through the GYRO e-statement service: the text layer is SHREDDED (one ~26k-char line of tokens in scrambled order, rotated words, adjacent right-aligned figures glued together, e.g. '4752.536135.96'). Only token runs whose order is stable on all 14 bills are used: the BTW row 'BTW <total> PTY Nr.: BTW <elec verbruik><elec basies> <water verbruik><water basies> <riool> <vullis> <total>' and the ex-VAT row '<n> <elec verbruik><elec basies> <water basies> <riool> <vullis> <SUB TOTAAL>' (glued pairs split by the fixed 2 decimals); kWh = the figure right after 'VERBRUIK' (followed by R/KWH or the 'nnnn/nnnn LESINGS' token); previous reading = the figure glued before the water block thresholds; current reading only where printed beside 'HUIDIGE'. No site name, tariff or meter number is recoverable. Account from the print-vendor tag '<!account|...' (same number as the address panel); statement date = the date printed beside the account (fallback: date after 'SKEUR'). FINGERPRINT: the municipality's BTW number as printed + name/domain. total_ex_vat_r = elec verbruik + basies (ex VAT); identity hq_check_sub_r = printed SUB TOTAAL ex VAT - water verbruik - water basies - riool - vullis (validates the glued-number split). Electricity VAT (BTW row) = 15% of total_ex_vat_r on every bill. Checked on 14 bills.

fields.label: Account (print-vendor tag, = the account on the address panel)
Statement date (date printed beside the account)
BTW row: total, elec verbruik/basies, water verbruik/basies, riool, vullis, total
Water verbruik ex VAT (first figure after KORTING MAAND)
Ex-VAT row: elec verbruik+basies (glued), water basies, riool, vullis, SUB TOTAAL EX
Electricity VORIGE reading (glued before the water block thresholds)
Electricity HUIDIGE reading (only when printed beside the label)
